source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_36/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_36_หน้า11.png
warnings: One sheet, two rows of four cells: doors ป1-ป4 on top, windows น1-น4 below; each cell = elevation with dimensions + the 6-row table. count is the printed จำนวน.

Every height is measured from the printed ระดับพื้นห้อง marker (no level value printed on this sheet). Window sill + window height add up to the printed overall in all four windows (0.75+1.30, 0.85+1.20 = 2.05; 1.65+0.50, 1.55+0.60 = 2.15).

ป1 prints an overall 2.60 above an inner row 0.50 / 0.70 / 0.70 / 0.50 (= 2.40). The inner dimensions do not share ticks — each sits between its own pair of extension lines with a gap for the jamb/mullion between them — so they are not expected to add to 2.60. Kept as printed in width_printed_as, not flagged as a misprint.

For ป2/ป3/ป4 the outer dimension (1.00 / 0.90 / 0.80) is the frame (วงกบ) width and the inner one (0.90 / 0.80 / 0.70) is the leaf, same reading as the sibling siamplan house 95 (น6). width_m = the outer value, leaf_width_m = the inner one.
